prompt: TaskQueue has inconsistent shutdown behavior: polling an empty queue throws and enqueue still accepts work after shutdown. Make empty poll return null, reject enqueue after shutdown with IllegalStateException, preserve FIFO order, and keep shutdown idempotent.

graders.name: fail_to_pass
graders.cmd: javac -encoding UTF-8 -d out src/*.java verify/FailToPass.java && java -cp out FailToPass

graders.name: pass_to_pass
graders.cmd: javac -encoding UTF-8 -d out src/*.java verify/PassToPass.java && java -cp out PassToPass
